summary: I often compare this mindset to classically trained musicians. Folks who can do the most beautiful things with directions and documentation but if you tell em to pick out a few notes and a scale to just jam they stare back at you blankly.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: I often compare this mindset to classically trained musicians. Folks who can do the most beautiful things with directions and documentation but if you tell em to pick out a few notes and a scale to just jam they stare back at you blankly.
